title: 2021 AMC 10B Problem 9
statement: The point \(P(a,b)\) in the \(xy\)-plane is first rotated counterclockwise by \(90^\circ\) around the point \((1,5)\) and then reflected about the line \(y = -x.\) The image of \(P\) after these two transformations is at \((-6,3).\) What is \(b - a ?\)

solutions.text:
Work backward. Reflecting \((-6,3)\) across \(y=-x\) gives \((-3,6).\)

Now undo the \(90^\circ\) counterclockwise rotation by rotating \((-3,6)\) clockwise about \((1,5).\) Relative to \((1,5),\) the point is \((-4,1).\) A clockwise quarter-turn sends this to \((1,4),\) and translating back gives \((2,9).\)

Thus \(a=2,\) \(b=9,\) and \(b-a=7.\)

Thus, the answer is D .
hints: Undo the rotation by translating the center of rotation to the origin
